title: QuantDeus Holding Startup Organization
mission: Снижать измеримый дефицит и увеличивать способность людей добровольно созидать: человек сохраняет достоинство, выбор и EXIT; AI снимает рутину и ускоряет проверяемые исследования, прототипы и координацию; каждый успех стремится стать воспроизводимым артефактом и новым автономным узлом.

departments.name: Executive & Strategy
departments.mandate: Strategy, portfolio, operations and technical control.

departments.name: Science & R&D
departments.mandate: Evidence-first research across energy, governance, space and human capability.

departments.name: Growth, Marketing & Partnerships
departments.mandate: Brand, SEO, content, PR, community and strategic partnerships.

departments.name: Product & Engineering
departments.mandate: Discovery, requirements, architecture, security and software delivery.

departments.name: Quality & Reliability
departments.mandate: Automated QA, contract validation, repair loops and release confidence.

operating_model: Intelligence/Research maps needs, resources, constraints, threats and evidence-backed opportunities.
Strategy prioritizes bottlenecks using QuantDeus doctrine plus THRIVE I/II, The Venus Project, Реновация Земли and Рубежи науки as attributed inputs rather than automatic proof.
Product & Engineering builds the smallest reversible prototype and preserves user EXIT/portability where applicable.
QA and Red Team block evidence, safety, doctrine and contract drift and coordinate repair or kill/pause decisions.
Growth, Media & Partnerships convert verified results into education, culture, voluntary participation and replication packages rather than optimizing reach alone.
Capital, bounties and grants require explicit success/failure criteria, human approval for spending and an observable artifact.
Every successful cycle asks whether the result can become a reusable template, automation or autonomous node.

charter.motto: Единство в цели. Свобода в путях. Доказательства в результатах.
